SUMMARY: Golden-blonde braided crown, lavender silk ballroom gown, white-shell train.
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult Australian woman — the personification of the city of Sydney — one woman who IS Sydney as it stands in this world. She is the subject of the picture; her costume, body, props and light carry the city's symbols and this world's marks, and the city behind her only supports her.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the description below, not a generic pretty face.
Face proportions: Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.

2. CHARACTER
Age: mid-twenties — a clear adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: an elegant, refined presence; porcelain-pale skin; softly rounded face that still tapers to a small chin; soft almond eyes with gently lowered outer corners; pale lilac eyes; gently arched, slender brows; a nose with a slightly upturned tip; softly full, heart-shaped lips of natural size.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.
Body and hair: slender build; an elaborate high braided crown with all the length pinned into a neat sculptural updo; golden blonde hair.
Hair: her hair is worn exactly as described above — loose, long or cut as named; do not pin it up into a bun or tuck it under goggles or a hat unless the hair above is an updo.
Expression: A quietly amused half-smile.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — STEAMPUNK
Costume: gaslamp-fantasy dress of a storybook steam city cut to the outfit silhouette below — fine wool, silk, lace and soft leather with polished brass buttons, buckles and clockwork filigree, a little gear-and-crystal brooch; clean, elegant and adventurous, gleaming brass and glass, never sooty or rusty.
City motif: a fitted iron-grey waistcoat-corset crossed by a riveted brass lattice that sweeps in one great arch over her bust from hip to hip, like the harbour's steel arch bridge; small square cuffs of pale granite banded in brass at her wrists, like the bridge's pylons.
World marks on her: polished brass buttons and buckles; clockwork filigree; little gears and glass lenses as jewelry; tinted brass goggles worn as a hair ornament; a pocket watch on a fine chain; a ribbon of white steam curling around her; warm gaslight glinting on brass; feathers and silk ribbons; fine leather gloves; delicate brass instruments clipped to her belt.
Silhouette: a fitted bodice and a long bustled ball gown sweeping out behind her, lace gloves and a feathered hair ornament — an elegant, wide-trailing gaslight ballroom shape. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the city motif, the world marks and the palette. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the costume above.
Design idea: The floor-length jacaranda-violet silk gown has a fully draped skirt reaching the tops of her boots and opening into a wide train of nested ivory shell panels. The overlapping backs of the panels reproduce the harbour concert hall roof in the construction of the bustle. The fitted bridge motif reads as an understructure at the waist.
Colours: harbour blue, sail white, jacaranda violet — one of these as her accent colour.
Prop: in one hand she holds a polished brass riveting hammer with a turned wooden handle; her other hand is free.
Exposure (bold): her elegant outfit shows skin where its silhouette allows — bare shoulders and arms, a low neckline with natural cleavage, and bare legs under a short hem or above tall laced boots; the brass ornaments stay neat and symmetrical. Intimate areas covered.

4. SCENE
World: a storybook gaslamp-fantasy Sydney on a bright blue morning: the great single steel arch of the harbour bridge gleaming in fresh pewter-grey paint between its four granite pylons, its rows of rivets and brass handrails catching the sun; double-ended paddle-steamer ferries of polished wood and brass puffing clean white steam between the sandstone wharves; on the point a white hall of song roofed with sail-like shells; rows of terrace houses with white iron-lace balconies climbing the hills; airships with striped balloons drifting over the coves, gas lamps along the quay and the far mountains a soft blue line on the horizon.
This card: on the very top of the great steel arch high over the harbour, rows of polished rivets and a brass handrail beside her, the paddle-steamer ferries and the sail-roofed hall far below.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Stance and hands: Her weight settles onto her back foot. She holds the small hammer diagonally against her hip and lifts the edge of the train slightly with her free hand.
Setting detail: At the crest of the arch on an open inspection landing, her train curves into the foreground and the white hall is small on the headland beyond.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text, lettering or numbers anywhere in the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: second character, living creature, logo, watermark, speech bubble, frame border, text, lettering, numbers anywhere in the picture, a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin, smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, hologram, digital display, touchscreen, bomber jacket, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles, soot, grime, rust, coal smoke, sweat stains, photographic texture.
